study type: Cohort study (follow-up of a randomized controlled trial)
exposure: Prior enrollment in the Fast Track and Standard Treatment Trial (FASTT) for unexplained infertility
Different methods of conception (e.g., natural, intrauterine insemination, in vitro fertilization)
cohort: The study participants were couples with unexplained infertility who had previously enrolled in the Fast Track and Standard Treatment Trial (FASTT).
finding: The majority of couples with unexplained infertility (80.9%) achieved a live birth after participating in the FASTT, with 6.6% never achieving one during their reproductive years, and pursuing treatment sooner was associated with increased satisfaction regarding family size.
followup_time: Approximately 16.4 years (mean age at enrollment 33.1 years, mean age at follow-up 49.5 years)
